name: @silurus/ooxml-markdown
description: Opt-in DOCX / XLSX / PPTX Markdown projection
author: Yuki Yokotani <silurus.dev@gmail.com>

scripts.wasm:pptx: cd parsers/pptx && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../../wasm/pptx && node ../../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../../wasm/pptx/ooxml_markdown_pptx.js
scripts.wasm:docx: cd parsers/docx && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../../wasm/docx && node ../../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../../wasm/docx/ooxml_markdown_docx.js
scripts.wasm:xlsx: cd parsers/xlsx && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../../wasm/xlsx && node ../../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../../wasm/xlsx/ooxml_markdown_xlsx.js
scripts.wasm: pnpm wasm:pptx && pnpm wasm:docx && pnpm wasm:xlsx
